description: Healthcare consulting firm offering expert assistance throughout every phase of the EHR lifecycle, including implementations, selection, optimization, and project management.

sentiment.label: positive

highlights.text: Working with Joxel for over a decade has been a pleasure. Consistently high-quality, timely work.
They not only fix problems but also teach and mentor our administrators, enhancing internal capacity.
Their biggest asset is the ability to be nimble and execute to a high-quality standard.
Joxel listens to the needs of the agency and staff and delivers an end product that reflects that.

sentiment.summary: Universally positive reputation with clients praising Joxel as a strategic, knowledgeable IT consulting partner delivering high-quality implementations, mentoring, and problem-solving across EHR systems.
